_README: One-off adjustments to filed net income that THIS repo can cite. Written by the Deep dive when it reconciles a filing by hand; read by fetch-prices.js, which subtracts them from filed `ni` to build an 'own' recurring basis beside Yahoo's `norm`. Never replaces filed figures. Every entry needs fy (the fiscal year END date as it appears in earnings.json), amount in the FILING's currency, what it was, and a source URL to the company's own release or filing. Positive amount = income to remove.

LULU.note: Yahoo's norm for this year equals filed ni exactly, so the vendor removed nothing.
